title: 扩散语言模型实验分析
summary: 对八种现代扩散语言模型（DLM）在推理、编码、翻译等八个基准上的系统实验分析，揭示了生成质量与计算效率之间的权衡，以及推理时设计选择（如去噪步数、上下文长度）对性能的显著影响。
summary_en: A systematic experimental analysis of eight state-of-the-art diffusion language models across eight benchmarks, revealing trade-offs between generation quality and computational efficiency, and the strong influence of inference-time design choices.
